messages:
Maya: quick thread  Auriga Systems case + micro-benchmark note. goal: publish next Tue 09:00 PT, include webinar CTA and a short methodology blurb. need interview audio/transcript, one approved hero quote, two social cards, and HubSpot routing. who can own ops?

Drew: I can run ops. scheduled interview with Auriga’s Head of ML for Fri 3pm PT. audio + transcript, ~25m. added recorder link to the checklist.

Felix: I'll write the hero and the micro-bench blurb. request: avoid absolute comparative claims, include dataset shape and sequence length notes.

Samir: Sales routing note  we want separate tags for case readers vs webinar registrants. Also add an AE webhook to #ae-live.

Maya: perfect. Felix, include a 2-3 sentence methodology paragraph that lives under a "How we measured" section.

Drew: checklist + recorder here: <https://drive.redwood/internal/checklists/auriga-2678>. CMS draft created at <https://cms.redwood/drafts/auriga-2678>.

Felix: draft hero: "Auriga Systems reduced p95 inference latency by roughly 3x and trimmed serving costs by 28% with Redwood." working on the bench blurb.

Samir: UTM template I'll use: ?utm_source=marketing&utm_campaign=auriga_case&utm_medium=post. HubSpot flow name = auriga_case_flow.

Maya: pinging legal early. LegalBot, please queue the quote for approval. need final approval by Mon EOD to hit Tue publish.

LegalBot: received. Please submit quote via <https://legal.redwood/submit?case=auriga-2678>. Typical review 24-48h.

Felix: draft methodology blurb: "How we measured: Auriga traffic (median sequence length ~96 tokens) was replayed against the baseline serving stack for 24 hours. We measured p95 latency and per-token serving cost during steady-state traffic; Redwood configuration used default KV caching and continuous batching. Results include a side-case where prefix caching improved token efficiency by ~7% in long-session traces."

Drew: recorder + transcript will be uploaded to the project folder after the call. please reference the template: <https://drive.redwood/internal/templates/case-interview>.

Maya: can marketing ops also prepare a short 20s social clip from the interview? good for X and LinkedIn. Drew, add to checklist.

Drew: added clip task; will export a 20s highlight and the transcript snippet.

Felix: proposed hero quote: "Redwood reduced our p95 latency by about 3x and reduced serving costs by 28%, letting us iterate on features faster." sending to LegalBot now.

LegalBot: initial review: replace "our" with company name in public quotes; avoid the word "reduced" twice in one sentence; request customer consent upload.

Felix: updated quote: "Redwood reduced Auriga Systems' p95 latency by about 3x and lowered serving costs by 28%, enabling faster product iteration." submitting.

Maya: customer consent? Drew, confirm we have signed release.

Drew: consent uploaded to the approval form and project folder: <https://drive.redwood/content/auriga-consent.pdf>.

LegalBot: approval granted with one stylistic edit (replace "about 3x" -> "about three times" in headline copy for readability on socials). Approval doc: <https://legal.redwood/approvals/auriga-2678/approved.pdf>.

Felix: applying edit. hero now: "Auriga Systems reduced p95 latency by about three times and lowered serving costs by 28% with Redwood." I'll keep the precise 3.05x in the methodology table.

Samir: HubSpot: created auriga_case_flow, applied UTMs, and set webinar_tag=auriga_webinar. AE webhook tested to #ae-live.

SalesOpsBot: HubSpot workflow created and tested. Sample lead delivered to AE queue with UTM params. Webhook payload includes lead.source=auriga_case and tag=auriga_webinar.

Maya: social cards and hero image? Felix where are assets?

Felix: assets uploaded: <https://drive.redwood/content/auriga-final-assets>. social card variations for X and LinkedIn in the folder. 20s clip uploaded as well.

Drew: CMS draft updated with approved quote, methodology blurb, and assets: <https://cms.redwood/drafts/auriga-2678>. Buffer scheduled for Tue 09:00 PT pending final QA.

Maya: final QA checklist: 1) CMS draft 2) legal approval 3) consent uploaded 4) HubSpot flow live 5) Buffer queued 6) assets uploaded. Everyone confirm.

Felix: confirmed.

Drew: confirmed.

Samir: confirmed.

LegalBot: approval archived; consent on file.

Maya: OK, we'll flip to publish Tue 09:00 PT. Drew, monitor AE queue for spikes and coordinate with SalesOps.

Drew: will monitor. I'll set a 48h AE rotation for the first two days and a 72h webhook retention.

Samir: added report to track demo conversions and webinar signups from auriga_case_flow.

Maya: thanks team  locking thread. I'll post the announce in #company after publish and share the bench blurb in the post. Closing once live. :rocket:
